suggested_experiment_name: Eot-Wash torsion balance ULMB search (Shaw et al. 2022)
coupling_convention: g_{B-L} (hbar c)^{-1/2}, dimensionless, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 5
notes: Eot-Wash stationary torsion balance with Be-Al B-L dipole (Shaw et al., arXiv:2109.08822). New measured 95% CL limits on g_B-L for vector ULMB dark matter, masses 1e-18 to 1e-16 eV. Only the best-point value is given explicitly in text: g_B-L < 1e-25 at m = 8e-18 eV (near torsion resonance f0 = 1.934 mHz). Other data points reconstructed from stated scaling behavior: limit ~ 1/sqrt(f) below resonance and ~ f above resonance; full numerical curve is only in Fig. 5, so intermediate points are approximate. Paper also reports similar limits for B-coupled and L-coupled bosons (Appendix Fig. 6), not extracted here.
